check_api_key.title: Check the validity of current use api key
check_api_key.description: Check that the API key in use is valid, and read what it is allowed to do. The cheapest call that proves the connection works.

output.description: The check api key result: email, name.

get_webhook.title: Get webhook from its ID
get_webhook.description: Fetch one webhook endpoint registered on the API key by id: its URL and the events it receives.

api_key_webhook_id.description: Id of the webhook, as returned by subscribe_webhook.

subscribe_webhook.title: Add webhook endpoint to an API key
subscribe_webhook.description: Add webhook endpoint to an API key. Requires url. Optional: events.

url.description: The HTTPS endpoint All-Images.ai should POST events to.

unsubscribe_webhook.title: Remove webhook endpoint from an API key
unsubscribe_webhook.description: Remove webhook endpoint from an API key. This cannot be undone.

api_webhook_id.description: Id of the webhook to remove, as returned by subscribe_webhook.

search_images.title: Search images
search_images.description: Search images. Optional: limit, offset, sort, search, filterFree.

limit.description: How many items to return per page.

offset.description: How many items to skip, for paging.

sort.description: Sort order as field and direction, e.g. createdAt:desc.

output.description: The search images result: filteredResults, images.

images.description: Each item is an object. Fields: id, url, urlFull, validate, free, titles. Required: id, url, urlFull.

list_downloaded_images.title: Search images downloaded
list_downloaded_images.description: Search images downloaded. Optional: limit, offset, sort, afterCreatedAt, beforeCreatedAt.

limit.description: How many items to return per page.

offset.description: How many items to skip, for paging.

sort.description: Sort order as field and direction, e.g. createdAt:desc.

output.description: The list downloaded images result: filteredResults, images.

images.description: Each item is an object. Fields: id, url, urlFull, urlUpscale, urlUpscaleUHD, downloadedAt. Required: id, url, urlFull, urlUpscaleUHD, downloadedAt.

buy_image.title: Buy Image
buy_image.description: Buy a generated or stock image by id, spending credits, and get back a direct URL to the full-resolution file. Use download_image to receive the binary file instead, and search_images to find ids.

output.description: The buy image result: id, url, urlFull, urlUpscale, urlUpscaleUHD, downloadedAt.

url.description: Direct link to download preview image

urlFull.description: Direct link to download full image

urlUpscale.description: Direct link to download upscale image

urlUpscaleUHD.description: Direct link to download upscale UHD image

download_image.title: Download Image
download_image.description: Download an image by id as a binary file (the response body is the image, not JSON), spending credits if it is not already bought. Use buy_image to get a URL instead.

display_image.title: Get image
display_image.description: Fetch the JPEG of an image in a given display format (e.g. preview or thumbnail). The response is the image file itself, not JSON.

image_id.description: Id of the image, from search_images or an image generation.

format.description: Display format of the image, e.g. preview.

list_image_generations.title: Get image generations
list_image_generations.description: Get image generations. Query options: limit, offset, sort, name, tag.

limit.description: How many items to return per page.

offset.description: How many items to skip, for paging.

sort.description: Sort order as field and direction, e.g. createdAt:desc.

output.description: The list image generations result: filteredResults, prints.

prints.description: Each item is an object. Fields: id, name, prompt, status, params, processMode, images, nbImages, tags, metaData, createdAt. Required: name, prompt, status, para

create_image_generation.title: Create an image generation
create_image_generation.description: Create an image generation. Requires name, mode, prompt. Optional: additionalPrompt, optimizePrompt, params, processMode, tags, metaData.

name.description: A name for the image generation, for your own reference.

mode.description: Generation mode: simple (a short subject, All-Images writes the prompt) or advanced (your full prompt is used as given).

additional_prompt.description: Additional Prompt, not affected by optimization if enabled. Added at the beginning

params.description: Advanced generation settings as an object, such as the aspect ratio, style and model options the image generation guide lists.

process_mode.description: Mode of the image generation (only for "Dedicated" user). Provider default: fast.

tags.description: Tags make it easy to find generations

meta_data.description: Pass on metadata to a ImageGeneration

output.description: The create image generation result: id, name, prompt, status, params, processMode, images, nbImages, ….

params.description: Each item is an object. Fields: name, value. Required: name, value.

processMode.description: Mode of the image generation (only for "Dedicated" user)

images.description: Each item is an object. Fields: id, url, urlFull, validate, free, titles. Required: id, url, urlFull.

delete_image_generations.title: Delete image generations
delete_image_generations.description: Delete one or more image generations by id (printIds). The generations and their images are removed and this cannot be undone.

update_image_generation.title: Update an image generation
update_image_generation.description: Update an image generation. Optional: name, mode, prompt, additionalPrompt, optimizePrompt, params, processMode, tags….

print_id.description: Id of the image generation to update.

name.description: A name for the image generation, for your own reference.

mode.description: Generation mode: simple (a short subject, All-Images writes the prompt) or advanced (your full prompt is used as given).

additional_prompt.description: Additional Prompt, not affected by optimization if enabled. Added at the beginning

params.description: Advanced generation settings as an object, such as the aspect ratio, style and model options the image generation guide lists.

process_mode.description: Mode of the image generation (only for "Dedicated" user). Provider default: fast.

tags.description: Tags make it easy to find generations

meta_data.description: Pass on metadata to a ImageGeneration

output.description: The update image generation result: id, name, prompt, status, params, processMode, images, nbImages, ….

params.description: Each item is an object. Fields: name, value. Required: name, value.

processMode.description: Mode of the image generation (only for "Dedicated" user)

images.description: Each item is an object. Fields: id, url, urlFull, validate, free, titles. Required: id, url, urlFull.

retry_image_generation.title: Retry an image generation failed
retry_image_generation.description: Retry an image generation that failed, re-queuing it with the same prompt and parameters.

image_generation_id.description: Id of the image generation, from list_image_generations or create_image_generation.

get_image_generation.title: Get an image generation
get_image_generation.description: Fetch one image generation by id: its status in the lifecycle (pending, in progress, completed, failed), prompt, parameters and the images produced.

image_generation_id.description: Id of the image generation, from list_image_generations or create_image_generation.

output.description: The get image generation result: id, name, prompt, status, params, processMode, images, nbImages, ….

params.description: Each item is an object. Fields: name, value. Required: name, value.

processMode.description: Mode of the image generation (only for "Dedicated" user)

images.description: Each item is an object. Fields: id, url, urlFull, validate, free, titles. Required: id, url, urlFull.

get_credits.title: Get credits
get_credits.description: Read the account's remaining credit balance. Buying images and creating image generations spend credits.

credits.description: Each item is an object. Fields: type, credit, creditTotal, unlimited. Required: credit.
